name: Spinosaurus (Saltwater)
label: Saltwater variant
title: Küstenwächter
note: The Spinosaurus that prefers salt water. It claims exactly one of the bright-green sea areas on the profile map (Kelp Vale, Coastal Bluffs, Abyssal Depths, Palm Islands or Stonebed Shoal), roams only inside it, and drinks at fresh water outside it that it never defends. Shares the official Spinosaurus profile with the freshwater variant.
